rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone travelling for pleasure.

example.english: This tourist came to Hong Kong to take photos.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 haak3 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for a person whose interest in a subject or scene is superficial and who lacks real expertise.

example.english: I'm just a tourist when it comes to tea ceremony, so I don't dare say much.
example.traditional: 我對茶道只係外行，唔敢亂講。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 caa4 dou6 zi2 hai6 ngoi6 haang4 m4 gam2 lyun6 gong2
